floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Area ranges follow the printed values. review.gallery: 7 Nshama design renders and 2 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. 1 additional DLD images are from the dated project album mirrored by Continental Club. Selected photographs depict the structure under construction.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 6 and 10. The project pin is from Continental Club’s project 3211 listing and aligns with the marked plot sector. The separate reused locator in the page schema was excluded.
review.floorPlans: 8 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. The brochure’s 1 BR Type A and 3 BR Type A sheets contain differences between the printed totals and some component sums. The figures shown follow the printed totals.
